entries.text: So you remember how Chuck really wanted to be part of our bowling team?
entries.translation: 你还记得查克很想加入我们的保龄球队吗？

entries.text: Oh yeah, he started to lay it on thick about how great he was to our team captain Marco.
entries.translation: 对，他开始对队长马可大肆吹嘘自己有多厉害。

entries.text: But I'm sure Marco didn't believe him.
entries.translation: 但我确信马可并不相信他。

entries.text: Chuck will be joining the team at our next practice.
entries.translation: 查克会在下一次训练时加入球队。

entries.text: To lay it on thick means to overstate something.
entries.translation: lay it on thick 的意思是夸大某件事。

entries.text: You try to say that something is much better or much worse than it really is because you want to impress someone.
entries.translation: 为了给人留下深刻印象，你会把某件事说得比实际好得多或糟得多。

entries.text: You can lay it on thick using blame or giving praises, like Chuck did with his bowling skills.
entries.translation: 你可以通过责备或过度赞美来夸大其词，就像查克吹嘘自己的保龄球技术那样。
